hub.title: Find your next destination
hub.text: Browse by interest, season and country, or ask for something specific. Every destination has an immersive preview.
hub.real360Text: Full 360° panoramas you can explore on a phone, a laptop or a VR headset.

dest.title: Destinations
dest.text: Filter by country, budget, season and travel style. Every destination comes with immersive previews, practical information and trusted local partners.
dest.bestTimeText: The best months to visit are {{months}}.
dest.confirmOfficial: Rules change: always confirm with official government sources before you travel.
dest.sustainabilityDefault: Choose local operators, respect wildlife distances and ask before photographing people.
dest.aiPrompt: Plan {{days}} days in {{place}} for two people
dest.whatsapp: Hello TravelMateVR, I'd like help planning a trip to {{name}}.
dest.demoNote: Prices, ratings and some listings are sample data while partners are being onboarded.
dest.operatorsText: No partners are listed in {{name}} yet. Tour operators, guides, stays and transport providers can apply now and be among the first.
dest.creatorsText: Film {{name}} in 360° and earn from every view of your experience, plus a share of subscriptions.

empty.title: Nothing matches these filters
empty.text: Try removing a filter or widening your budget.

vr.title: Experience before you travel
vr.text: 360° videos first, then 360° photos and panoramic previews of destinations, stays and community experiences, on any screen.

phone.title: On your phone
phone.text: Drag to look around, or turn on motion to explore by moving your phone.

desktop.title: On a computer
desktop.text: Drag with the mouse, zoom with the wheel, or use the arrow keys.

headset.title: In a VR headset
headset.text: Open TravelMateVR in your headset’s browser and choose “Headset” on any 360° experience.

vr.captureNote: 360° videos and 360° photos are full spherical captures. Panoramic previews show a regular photo until a creator captures the place in 360°.
vr.viewerLabel: 360° view: {{title}}. Drag or use arrow keys to look around.
vr.loadError: We couldn't load this experience right now. Please try again.
vr.hintTouch: Drag or turn on motion to look around
vr.previewNote: This is a panoramic preview of a photo. A full 360° capture is on our production list.
vr.xrHint: Headset mode is available in WebXR browsers, such as the Meta Quest Browser.
vr.xrFailed: We couldn't start headset mode. Check that your headset is connected and try again.
vr.videoText: Press play and look around: drag, tilt your phone or use a headset.
vr.videoNote: This is a 360° video: it starts muted, so turn the sound on if you like. You can look around while it plays.
vr.videoFallback: The 360° video can’t play on this device or connection, so you’re seeing a 360° still from it instead.
vr.creatorsText: {{count}} experiences are still waiting for a 360° capture. Vloggers, 360° filmmakers and local operators earn from every view and from subscriptions.

text.all: Stays, safaris, activities, restaurants, transport and events from trusted local partners, with transparent prices and a preview of every place.
text.stay: Hotels, lodges, tented camps and guesthouses, each with a 360° or panoramic preview.
text.safari: Day trips, private and small-group safaris from verified operators.
text.activity: Hikes, water activities and guided tours.
text.restaurant: From Swahili kitchens to bush dinners.
text.transport: Transfers, light aircraft, ferries and vehicles with drivers.
text.event: Music nights, markets and seasonal events.
text.local: Tours, food, crafts and traditional knowledge, hosted by the people who live there.

market.sampleNote: Listings marked “Sample listing” are demo businesses that show how the marketplace works. Listings from our founding partners show indicative prices until the partner confirms rates.
market.communityTitle: When you book local, the value stays local
market.communityText: These experiences are run by communities and small family businesses. Fees go to hosts directly or through community funds, as noted on each listing.

listing.indicative: Prices are indicative. {{partner}} confirms the final rate and itinerary when you send a request.
listing.susCommunity: Community-led: hosts receive the income directly
listing.susContribution: USD {{amount}} per booking goes to a conservation or community fund
listing.susVerified: We show eco and community claims only when the partner has provided evidence. Report a concern through the Help Center.
listing.request: Request to book: {{partner}} confirms within their response time
listing.whatsapp: Hello, I'm interested in “{{title}}” by {{partner}} on TravelMateVR.
listing.sampleProvider: This is a fictional sample business used to demonstrate the marketplace.
listing.newPartner: {{partner}} is a new partner on TravelMateVR. Reviews will appear here after verified bookings.
listing.closedWarn: This listing is closed in the month you picked.
listing.trustPrice: Full price shown before you pay
listing.trustPay: Secure payment through our payment partner
listing.blackoutWarn: The partner is closed on {{date}}. Please choose other dates.
listing.soldOutWarn: Fully booked on {{date}}. Try other dates or fewer rooms.

cancellation.flexible: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start. No refund after that.
cancellation.moderate: Full refund up to 7 days before the start, 50% refund up to 48 hours before. No refund after that.
cancellation.strict: Full refund up to 30 days before the start, 50% refund up to 14 days before. No refund after that.

partner.realNote: {{name}} is a founding partner of TravelMateVR. Rates and itineraries are confirmed directly by the partner.
partner.whatsapp: Hello, I'd like to ask {{name}} about a trip, via TravelMateVR.
partner.whatsappNote: WhatsApp messages go to the TravelMateVR team, who connect you with the partner.
partner.contributes_one: {{count}} listing contributes to a conservation or community fund
partner.contributes_other: {{count}} listings contribute to conservation or community funds
